div.class: d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-end gap-2 mb-2

div.p: Latest news and notifications from Human Resources.

a.t-attf-class: bunna-ann-pill #{'active' if selected_category and selected_category.id == c.id else ''}

div.label: Date

div.label: Sort by

button.title: Tell the moderators this comment is inappropriate

form.label: Add an anonymous comment
form.p: Comments are anonymous: no name, account or IP address is saved with your comment. A comment appears only after it has been reviewed. Please do not write personal or confidential information. To limit spam, a one-way code that changes every day is counted for up to two hours; it is never linked to your comment.

div.p: Comments are closed for this announcement.
